title: THE SINKHOLE · The table, after
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: The third found page: the diner the morning after, Table 14 set and empty, a coffee poured for it, a bartender who has worked there since '83 not looking at it, and the dog under the booth looking at the door. The page Wood will draw with a stool and a saucer, years later, without having seen this. Or having.

panels.composition: A full Sunday page in three tiers: a diner in morning light with one numbered table set and empty and a full coffee before its chair; a bartender behind the well wiping a glass with his back to the table; a dog under a booth looking at the door.
